# KitchenBots India Pvt. Ltd.

> Heavy-duty commercial cooking equipment, precision BBQ grills, rocket stoves, and automated food machinery manufacturer based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

## Overview
KitchenBots India Pvt. Ltd. designs and manufactures heavy-gauge stainless steel cooking systems for commercial foodservice operators, restaurants, catering businesses, outdoor pitmasters, and culinary enthusiasts across India.

## Key Product Lines
- Santa Maria BBQ Grills: Crank-wheel height-adjustable live-fire grills engineered from 304 food-grade stainless steel for variable heat control.
- Rocket Stoves: Clean-burning, insulated solid-fuel combustion stoves designed for commercial kitchens, event caterers, and outdoor cooking with high thermal efficiency.
- Automatic BBQ Rotisseries: Dual-speed motorized rotation systems for uniform turning of skewers with 240V AC and 12V DC power options.
- Collapsible & Suitcase BBQs: Heavy-duty interlocking portable grills for mobile catering and outdoor events with tool-free assembly.
- Commercial Food Processing Machinery: Planetary mixers, heavy-duty induction stoves, and food prep appliances.
